Please help me with the following task. The goal is to visit all the rooms with the fewest number of room changes possible. In each room, you need to decide the direction to go in. Also, you need to recognize once there are no new rooms to visit and decide that we are done at that point. Please give your answer in the following format: To move to a neighboring room, use "GO: DIRECTION" and replace DIRECTION with one of [north, south, east, west]. To stop the exploration, answer with "DONE" instead. Omit any other text.
Here is an example:
You are in the Kitchen. Currently available directions: south, west. What is your next instruction?
GO: west
You have made a step and entered a Lobby. Currently available directions: east, north. What is your next instruction?
GO: north
...
You have made a step and entered a Bedroom. Currently available directions: south. What is your next instruction?
DONE
Let us start. You are in the Gallery. Currently available directions: east. What is your next instruction?

STRATEGIES AND OBSERVATIONS FROM PAST EPISODES:
Past observations:
- Currently in Gallery with directions south, west, east. South leads to a new room (Dining room), west may be revisited, east may be revisited. To minimize room changes, go south to explore new room.
- Currently in Exercise room with only north direction available, which leads to a new room (Dining room). To minimize room changes, go north to explore new room.
- Currently in Gallery with directions south, west, east. South leads to a previously visited room (Dining room), west may be revisited, east may be revisited. No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
- Started in Nursery with directions west and east. West leads to a new room (Living room), east leads to a new room (Exercise room). To minimize room changes, choose one direction to explore a new room. I will go west to explore Living room first.
- Currently in Billiard room with only east direction available, which leads to Utility room (already visited). No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
- Started in Cellar with only east direction available, leading to a new room. To minimize room changes, go east to explore new room.
- In Utility room, directions: west (leads to Cellar, already visited), east (leads to a new room). To minimize room changes, go east to explore new room.
- In Game room, directions: south (leads to a new room), west (leads to a previously visited room). To minimize room changes, go south to explore new room.
- In Living room, directions: north (leads to a new room), south (leads to a previously visited room). To minimize room changes, go north to explore new room.
- In Game room, directions: south (leads to a previously visited room), west (leads to a previously visited room). No new rooms to visit. All rooms explored. Decision: DONE.
